suite.doc: Data-driven tests for https://testsheepnz.github.io/BasicCalculator.html. One test case = one record of calculator_test_data.py passed as the argument of the template keyword. The build is a parameter: `robotcode robot --variable BUILD:3` runs the same test cases against Build 3 (0 = Prototype); `--include TC01` or `--include severity-Critical` narrows the run.
